argv: MatterControl Step02.3 integration API auth decision gate
Independently review the Step02.3 proposal documents and define the acceptance matrix. Follow the packet JSON output schema; no tools, files or runtime execution.
scope: independent proposal/testability review and future test matrix; no runtime replay

findings.issue: T11 asserts details.detail equals 'the pinned golden/docs string', but the literal 503 detail text is not present in the packet and docs/api.md was not reviewed; no golden value or retention path is identified, so the matrix cannot execute an exact-match assertion from packet content alone.
findings.required_change: At ARCH-FINAL, pin the exact retained C01 golden 503 detail string (with its evidence reference from the C01 closure/verification manifest) into the finalized contract and the matrix FIX-SET so the equality assertion is checkable without manufacturing contract text.

findings.issue: The phrasing 'Harness-only endpoints, if required by the finalized proposal, are temporary test contracts' presents approval of the harness endpoint as conditional, while the authoritative proposal §2/§5 makes explicit PO approval of the harness endpoint a mandatory part of selecting INT-A.
findings.required_change: Reword the INT-A trade-off cell so the harness-only endpoint approval is stated as explicit and required within the INT-A selection.

findings.issue: The document still presents the earlier round's two options (a) transport-only and (b) defer as Claude's proposal, while the correction-round-1 analysis (INT-A, INT-A0, INT-B, INT-C) supersedes them without a pointer marking the newer option set as governing.
findings.required_change: Add one line to §2 pointing to docs/architecture/integration-scope-proposal.md and api-auth-decision-analysis.md as the current governing INT-D01 option set, preserving the earlier text as historical context.
